scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That flat-pack cupboard's leaning. I could take a look.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got the instructions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Which page explains that leftover door?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold it for a second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Just to clarify: you're asking for my help?

responseLogic.evidence: A3 tests B2's instructions against the leftover door; A5 exploits B4's request to hold it.

relationship.evidence: B2 asserts self-sufficiency, but B4 needs practical assistance.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's small request into an admission of dependence.

specificity.evidence: A1's leaning flat-pack cupboard and A3's leftover door establish playable trouble.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Just to clarify' earns its politeness through B4's reluctant request.

cardFidelity.evidence: A5 seeks explicit acknowledgment of help even after B4 requests practical assistance; admission is A's objective.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 challenges B2's instructions using the leftover door; A5 converts B4's holding request into an admission.

relationship.evidence: B2 protects competence and B4 accepts only a small assist, giving A a credible reluctant recipient.

heightening.evidence: A5 advances from A1's offer and A3's teasing evidence to requiring recognition of dependence.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a leaning flat-pack cupboard; A3's leftover door makes the practical problem immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's page question and A5's clarification earn their humor through A's insistence on acknowledgment.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 claims the instructions suffice; A3 asks which page accounts for the visibly leftover door.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 requests help holding the door; A5 asks B to recognize that request as help.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: D01 explains why A5 pursues a verbal admission instead of simply holding the door.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A1 offers competence, A3 undermines self-sufficiency, and A5 presses for acknowledgment.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A converts a practical request into an explicit admission that B needs A's help.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Displaying competence could resemble D09's pursuit of recognition.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A5 asks whether B needs help rather than asking B to praise A's assembly skills.

records.recommendedEdit: Retained after rereading the original: B2 and B4 each supply the next tactic, and the final request precisely pursues D01.
records.remainingConcern: A5 states the objective quite explicitly, but the practical request earns it. Retain unchanged.
records.writerReservation: B4 has already implicitly acknowledged needing help, so A5 heightens explicitness more than practical stakes.
records.alternativeComparison: Alternative a exploits an organically emerging need; b introduces control over access to the heater's fuse box.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not cold.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Shall I leave myself? I know where the fuse box is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought a blanket. Your heater's still broken?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm managing. Leave the blanket, though.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. Would you say you needed my help?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need the blanket. I can reset the heater myself.

beats.speaker: A

heightening.evidence: A5 introduces repair expertise but does not increase pressure for acknowledgment.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a broken heater and jumper, though 'Shall I leave myself?' in A5 is awkward.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's withdrawal is economical; A5's phrasing obscures the intended bargaining move.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 explicitly seeks acknowledgment of needed help; A5 counters B4's claim of independent heater repair.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's request to leave the blanket; A5 answers B4's reset plan with locked fuse-box access.

relationship.evidence: B2 accepts the object while preserving independence, and B4 distinguishes needing a blanket from needing A.

heightening.evidence: B4's repair claim prompts A5 to move from seeking gratitude for warmth to controlling practical access.

specificity.evidence: A1's broken heater and blanket are clear; A5's locked cupboard is playable but establishes access arrangements late.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'wait while you manage' economically returns B2's self-sufficient language as pressure.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 asks to keep the blanket despite claiming to manage; A3 seeks an admission from that concession.

hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 turns B's alternative solution into another occasion to acknowledge needing A.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A uses B's practical dependence to seek a spoken admission that A's help is needed.

records.recommendedEdit: Revised within the heater setting to clarify the target admission. Internal reread scores fidelity/logic/relationship/heightening/specificity/wit 5/5/4/4/4/4 = 90; B4's repair claim makes A5's access obstacle consequential. Five spoken turns, under 75 words.
records.remainingConcern: The locked cupboard is convenient leverage introduced only in A5, and its ownership leaves the relationship somewhat unspecified. Retain unchanged with that reservation.
records.writerReservation: The newly established locked cupboard gives A considerable leverage; actors should preserve sincere helpfulness rather than imply deliberate sabotage.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike a's opportunistic clarification of a requested assist, b uses a warmer opening followed by sharper access-based leverage.

beats.text: Perfect. That's when the bread comes out.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've bought a replacement mug. Not that anyone needs to say anything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did I break your mug?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Interesting that you started there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry about the mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep that tone. Think a little more recently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put your usual mug out. We can still have tea.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Still? Are you cross with me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm hoping you won't leave me cross.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry you feel that way.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you try one where you're sorry about yourself? I'll keep the tea warm.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 encourages B's inference; A5 seeks another apology without specifying the actual offense.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's mug guess and A5 redirects B4's apology toward something more recent.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 cooperate, but A5 reveals that the supplied grievance was a decoy.

heightening.evidence: A5 raises the demand from one apology to identifying a further offense.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a replacement mug, although the actual relational situation remains hidden.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Keep that tone' efficiently recycles the apology as a starting point.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 makes tea conditional on reconciliation; A3 solicits repair and A5 requests personal remorse without identifying the offense.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 supplies 'cross,' which A3 turns into B's responsibility to remedy; B4's evasive apology directly prompts A5's requested correction.

relationship.evidence: A1's usual mug establishes familiarity; B2 seeks clarification and B4 offers a defensive concession that changes A5's tactic.

heightening.evidence: A3 hints at reconciliation; after B4 technically apologizes, A5 raises the requirement to accepting responsibility while preserving the tea invitation.

specificity.evidence: A1's usual mug and tea establish a readily playable domestic encounter; A5 keeps that hospitality active during the negotiation.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'sorry about yourself' economically reverses B4's 'sorry you feel that way,' with the warm tea sustaining A's sincere conciliatory pose.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 asks whether A is cross; A3 adopts that description and implies B should remedy it.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 apologizes for A's feelings; A5 specifically redirects the apology toward B's own responsibility.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 maneuver toward an apology while leaving the offense unnamed.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from seeking any repair to demanding a less evasive apology, without withdrawing A1's hospitality.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A signals unresolved hurt and draws out apologies while leaving the offense unnamed.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Vague reproach alone can resemble passive aggression without an actionable apology target.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A3 makes repairing the hurt B's responsibility; A5 seeks remorse for B's conduct after B4 apologizes only for A's feelings, without asking what happened.

records.recommendedEdit: Corrected the rejected candidate's B4 and A5 to remove information fishing while preserving its tea setting and exact original firstPass. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, because A3 and A5 solicit remorse without naming the offense; logic 5, because A3 answers B2's recognition of anger and A5 corrects B4's feelings-only apology; relationship 4, because B4 offers reconciliation while avoiding responsibility; heightening 4, because A5 raises the demand from soothing A to regretting B's conduct; specificity 4, because A1's usual mug establishes familiar hospitality but leaves the relationship implicit; wit 4, because A5's warm tea sustains the invitation through another apology attempt. Total 90. Five spoken ABABA turns, under 75 words; the exchange remains open.
records.remainingConcern: A5's 'sorry about yourself' can sound like a request for self-condemnation rather than accountability. This is a minor wording reservation; no rewrite is needed.
records.writerReservation: A5 is a fairly direct correction of an apology. Its increase is in accountability rather than external stakes; no independent or live review is claimed.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved D03-single-b uses an approaching parental visit and failed text communication as leverage. This alternative uses domestic hospitality and correction of an evasive spoken apology.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.text: These eighty wedding place cards need names. Your bin labels have better lettering than our invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like calligraphy. I hate copying guest lists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd read the names. You'd only do the beautiful part.

beats.speaker: B
